root.description:
# ORB-254 task preparation

Project: orbit. Source: ORB-254 / cc94ee40-210a-4ca3-bde5-96f3e38d9a63.
Issue: https://linear.app/nckrtl/issue/ORB-254/keep-javascript-runtime-test-commands-inside-their-fixture
Baseline: authoritative main c65cc09217da76a9d4f538f70f2337a3cab78f9c.
Flow: discovery; Incus not required. This repairs local test simulation, not
managed-machine privilege behavior. No UI or maintained documentation change.

## Root group

Title: Keep JavaScript runtime test commands inside their fixture
Objective: deliver all four ORB-254 acceptance items without changing production
provisioning or weakening verification isolation.
One direct executable child, no dependencies. The helper and its consumers
form one bounded reviewable change; splitting them would leave false evidence.
This approved Commander task package replaces legacy issue planning only for
ORB-254; preserve native flow and artifact support, no competing .loop task list.

## Shared context

Use the published issue's complete scope and ordered acceptance items. Governing
accepted ADRs are 0054,0058,0059 and docs/reference/implementation-loop.md.
Read nearest AGENTS and applicable Gateway test guidance for the assigned
worktree. No architectural/product decision is being changed.

Current helper in apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Nodes/NodeRolePrerequisiteCommandFactoryTest.php
isolates the production publication fragment, rewrites paths/chown, and builds
six disposable version binaries. It leaves the six sudo calls unadapted and
inherits host PATH. The legacy-launcher success test fails under NoNewPrivileges;
the npx rollback test can pass before npx runs. Adjacent Composer/Vite fixtures
show test-local adaptations, but choose a narrow solution justified by actual
invocations; do not introduce a global permissive sudo stub.

Observed main run: /home/nckrtl/apps/commander/tasks/storage/app/private/main-verification-launcher.N14MPK/php-launcher-r3/run-228942cb8ceb9151.
It executed3449 Gateway tests,3448 pass/1fail,19729 assertions; full command
exit1. Gateway quality, four ORB250 controls and50/50 native observations passed.
All51 ORB249 and16 ORB250 cases passed; this does not make the whole run green.
Result SHA256088cfc5525d5434ad46be16296b3ec8f6d91efdaf19a1c01fcbe8bce5593357d.
Keep all existing main incidents. ORB249/250 are already merged; ORB251 is a
separate retained reporting repair. Do not absorb it or alter its tests.

## Executable child

Title: Isolate launcher version checks and prove the intended rollback failure
Objective: repair only the local JavaScript publication helper and its affected
tests to satisfy the following criteria in one reviewer-created commit.

- T1/F1: Legacy success executes all six intended fixture version checks without real sudo or privilege escalation. Retain exact command/target and observed result evidence.
- T2/F2: Intended npx failure is actually reached, its result is preserved, exact existing launcher survives, and only newly published entries are removed. Include a negative control for an earlier failure so generic process failure cannot satisfy this result.
- T3/F3: Unexpected privileged command shape or target is rejected inside the fixture boundary; it cannot delegate to host sudo or a nonfixture executable. Assert this with deterministic negative controls, without weakening production commands.
- T4/F4: Foreign-launcher rejection and cleanup remain correct; the production factory and unrelated files remain unchanged.

Run meaningful affected Gateway TIA tests and composer check. Use unfiltered
TIA, without Pest path/filter/group/suite switches. For F1, run the repaired
cases under the existing non-root no-new-privileges/private sandbox boundary
and retain executed-case evidence. A zero-selected gate is not acceptance.
Adapt only task-owned invocation of the existing sandbox machinery to the
assigned uncommitted snapshot; the coordinator's main-only launcher is not a
candidate gate and must not be changed or pointed at a falsely labeled main.
Use project-local disposable DB/config/cache, sanitize inherited Commander
environment, preserve real HOME, and do not touch real databases or host sudo.
If a check needs a missing safe execution capability, report the exact gap;
do not remove NoNewPrivileges, run root tests or copy another task's pass.

Submit uncommitted changes and criterion-by-criterion actual command, cwd, exit,
result and retained evidence through the assigned Commander receipt. Yield.
Same implementer handles review corrections; only the retained independent
reviewer commits after its pass. No merge, incident clearance or cleanup here.

## Final integrated acceptance

- I1: Independent reviewer verifies F1–F4/T1–T4 against the exact uncommitted tree and actual evidence, then creates one clean commit on the assigned base after a pass.
- I2: Builder runs root composer check on the exact clean candidate across all five projects; retain repository-produced candidate/tree receipt and every real exit. Commander and final reviewer validate that receipt without treating TIA selection as acceptance.
- I3: Separate integrated review verifies all four issue outcomes, scope and artifact evidence before completing the root. Candidate approval does not clear the observed main incident; reviewed publication/merge and actual-main verification remain coordinator-owned closeout.


Preparation approved under the active Orbit delivery goal. Exact draft SHA256 f99886dd1cb0541a7892ff425cc18a66e976288b6d372a8c59301f8a837039d0; independent preparation PASS retained at /home/nckrtl/apps/commander/tasks/storage/app/private/orbit-main-repair-window.9cl0CQ6N/ORB254-PREPARATION-REVIEW.md. Approval covers brief/order, not implementation proof.

handoff.evidence:
Flow and submission: discovery; Incus not required by the approved ORB-254 package. Worktree /fast/worktrees/orbit/orb-254, branch orb-254, assigned HEAD/base c65cc09217da76a9d4f538f70f2337a3cab78f9c. No commit was created. The exact uncommitted submission changes only apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Nodes/NodeRolePrerequisiteCommandFactoryTest.php. File SHA256 24e7229ca519cd7beb8045b53505a0775949b3dcbafb693c70e8d7fc8dc86da0; git diff --binary SHA256 9082e5917f449edbf8fc5d502235a0a31336e96701c42bf08b8ea0bdf9c5e430. origin/main is one commit ahead; it was not integrated because the approved discovery package binds this task to the stated base and no landing conflict was encountered.

T1/F1: Test `accepts existing Orbit launchers for the old Vite Plus home` runs the isolated production publication fragment through an absolute fail-closed fixture adapter. It observes, in order, `-u nckrtl -H <fixture-stable>/vp --version => 0`, node => 0, pnpm => 0, npm => 0, npx => 0, and `-u nckrtl -H env BUN_INSTALL=/opt/orbit/bun <fixture-stable>/bun --version => 0`; it also checks all five exact legacy launcher contents. The adapter rejects unless the user, -H shape, optional Bun environment, --version argument, and executable target are exact, and the helper refuses unless exactly six production sudo calls were adapted and no sudo token remains. Machine check: `/usr/local/bin/composer test:affected -- --fresh --fail-on-warning --fail-on-empty-test-suite --log-teamcity=<retained>/gateway-tests.teamcity --tmp-dir=<retained>/paratest`, cwd `/home/nckrtl/apps/commander/tasks/storage/app/private/orb254-implementation.xX94f3/run/checkout/apps/gateway`, transient unit orbit-orb254-11-final-xX94f3, exit 0. The private snapshot is bound to the same base, file hash, and diff hash. Boundary observation: UID/GID 1000, mount namespace mnt:[4026537029] distinct from host mnt:[4026531832], NoNewPrivs=1, ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateTmp=yes, PrivateNetwork=yes, real HOME=/home/nckrtl, SQLite DB_DATABASE=:memory:, clean inherited environment via env -i. The fresh unfiltered suite passed 3452 tests / 19771 assertions. The exact T1 case started once, finished once, failed 0, ignored 0. Retained: `/home/nckrtl/apps/commander/tasks/storage/app/private/orb254-implementation.xX94f3/run/output/orb254-case-proof.json`, `gateway-tests.teamcity`, `gateway-tests.stdout`, `gateway-tests.exit`, `machine-boundary.txt`, `pre-sandbox-baseline.txt`, `systemd-units.log`.

T2/F2: Test `preserves exact launchers while rolling back new entry points after verification fails` observes vp/node/pnpm/npm exits 0 followed by the intended npx target exit 23, asserts the publication process preserves exit 23, preserves the byte-exact existing vp launcher and an unrelated stable file, removes only newly published node/pnpm/npm/npx/bun entries, and leaves no candidate directory. Negative control `distinguishes an earlier version failure from the intended npx rollback failure` observes only vp => 0 and node => 19, preserves process exit 19 and the exact existing launcher, proves npx was not reached, removes the new entries, and leaves no candidate directory. Both cases started and finished exactly once with no fail/ignore event in the same exit-0 sandbox run. Working directory, machine unit, command, and retained evidence are the T1 paths above; exact case mapping is in `orb254-case-proof.json`.

T3/F3: Dataset test `rejects privileged version checks outside the fixture contract` has two deterministic negative controls. Missing `-H` is rejected with adapter exit 125 and the exact `Rejected JavaScript runtime fixture command (shape)` command. A target at `<fixture-root>/nonfixture` is rejected with exit 125 and the exact `(target)` command; its execution marker remains absent. Both controls record no accepted version check, roll back every new entry, and leave no candidate directory. Both dataset cases started once, finished once, failed 0, ignored 0 in the exit-0 sandbox run. The helper uses an absolute adapter path and rejects any unadapted sudo token, so neither control can delegate to host sudo. Evidence: task test source plus the T1 machine paths and `orb254-case-proof.json`.

T4/F4: Existing test `rejects foreign launchers before publishing stable entry points` still asserts the exact conflict, preserves foreign npm bytes, publishes no other entry, and now also asserts candidate cleanup. It started once, finished once, failed 0, ignored 0 in the sandbox evidence. `git diff -- apps/gateway/app/Infrastructure/Nodes/Roles/NodeRolePrerequisiteCommandFactory.php` and `git diff -- docs` were empty; `git diff --name-only` listed only the assigned test file. Production factory and unrelated files are unchanged. Documentation: no maintained documentation change, as the approved package states this is a local simulation repair with no product/API/UI behavior change. The helper PHPDoc was updated for its returned fixture evidence.

Required local checks: (1) initial `composer guidance:check`, cwd apps/gateway, exit 0, 12 tests / 267 assertions. (2) `/usr/local/bin/composer test:affected` with no Pest path/filter/group/suite and a sanitized env preserving HOME, cwd apps/gateway, final exit 0, selected the changed NodeRolePrerequisiteCommandFactoryTest.php, 44 passed / 351 assertions; retained `local-gateway-test-affected-final.log`. (3) `/usr/local/bin/composer check`, same cwd and sanitized environment, exit 0: guidance 12/12 and 267 assertions, Rector OK, Pint 1105 files PASS, Larastan no errors; retained `local-gateway-composer-check.log`. (4) `git diff --check`, cwd worktree root, exit 0. (5) machine command described under T1, exit 0. SHA256 bindings for retained outputs are in `/home/nckrtl/apps/commander/tasks/storage/app/private/orb254-implementation.xX94f3/run/output/SHA256SUMS`.

Failed/check-not-run evidence: `composer guidance:update` regenerated three task-unrelated testing-guidance files and then failed one guidance contract; those files were restored exactly to the assigned baseline and the later required guidance/check gate passed. No retained file was made for that diagnostic command. The first local TIA attempt exited 1 only because the disposable command overrode the fixed ORBIT_HOME; OrbitHomeTest reported expected `/tmp/orbit-gateway-testing` versus supplied evidence path while the ORB-254 test file passed. After removing that setup override, its one failed case passed, then the final changed-file TIA run passed; retained `local-gateway-test-affected-setup-failure.log` and `local-gateway-test-affected-setup-rerun.log`. The first sandbox unit exited 1 before Pest because its status assertion expected a repository-root path while running from apps/gateway. A traced fresh unit confirmed that exact setup error. The external task-owned sandbox script was corrected to bind Git status/diff from the private checkout root, then the fresh final unit passed. Retained `service.log`, `service-debug.log`, and `systemd-units.log`; these are environment/setup failures and checks not run, not product failures. Root five-project composer check was not run because I2 assigns it to the later Builder on the reviewer-created clean commit. Incus was not run because the approved task explicitly classifies ORB-254 as Incus-not-required. No required final check is failed or unrun.

Machine changes and cleanup: no Incus topology, fleet Node, production service, real database, or external harness was changed. Three transient local systemd units were created for the sandbox attempts; all now report LoadState=not-found, ActiveState=inactive, SubState=dead after --collect. Each sandbox-private `/tmp` was removed with its namespace. The copied uncommitted private checkout, task-owned sandbox helper, Composer/cache data, and evidence remain intentionally at `/home/nckrtl/apps/commander/tasks/storage/app/private/orb254-implementation.xX94f3` for review. The earlier `/tmp/orb-254-evidence.YcwRG5` scratch path no longer exists after retained logs were copied; the trash backend reported that recovery on the internal mount is unsupported, so recovery is not promised. Limitations: none beyond the explicitly deferred independent review, reviewer commit, and I2 Builder gate.

issue.title: Keep JavaScript runtime test commands inside their fixture
issue.description:
Gateway's JavaScript runtime publication tests execute their local fixtures without requiring real sudo or privilege escalation. On main `c65cc09217da76a9d4f538f70f2337a3cab78f9c`, a fresh non-root Gateway run under `NoNewPrivileges=yes` executes 3,449 cases but fails `accepts existing Orbit launchers for the old Vite Plus home`: the test helper still invokes real sudo. The adjacent rollback case can pass on this early failure without reaching its intended failing runtime.

## Scope

* In: `role_javascript_runtime_harness` and its publication, conflict and rollback cases in `apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Infrastructure/Nodes/NodeRolePrerequisiteCommandFactoryTest.php`.
* Out: production provisioning commands, managed-user privilege policy, JavaScript installation or launcher behavior, Composer dependencies, test-host privileges, and sandbox protection changes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Existing valid legacy launchers are accepted and the six intended fixture runtime version checks execute successfully without invoking host sudo or requiring privilege escalation. Proof: affected Gateway TIA tests with explicit invocation evidence, including the legacy-launcher case in the unchanged non-root no-new-privileges verification sandbox.
- [ ] The rollback case demonstrably reaches the intended failing runtime and preserves its failure, retains the exact existing launcher, and removes only newly published entries; a failure before that runtime does not satisfy the case. Proof: affected Gateway TIA tests with ordered invocation and intended-failure assertions, plus a negative control that causes an earlier check to fail.
- [ ] Unexpected privileged command shapes or targets cannot escape to host sudo or execute outside the fixture-owned command boundary. Proof: deterministic test-local negative controls that reject unexpected invocations without treating them as the expected runtime failure.
- [ ] Existing foreign-launcher rejection and fixture cleanup remain correct, and the production command factory is unchanged. Proof: affected Gateway TIA regression cases, fixture-state assertions and exact candidate diff inspection.
